_meta.description: Module-load performance baseline (T-030). Measures first dynamic import of the @goli-cli/agent-core brain index within a fresh vitest worker.
_meta.methodology: wall-clock ms around a single `await import('@goli-cli/agent-core')` (first load only — module graph is cached on subsequent imports). This metric measures vite-node's COLD esbuild transform of the agent-core source graph, which is inherently noisy (30%+ run-to-run variance); the 50% per-metric tolerance is set accordingly — it is a coarse 'importing the brain got catastrophically heavy' sentinel, NOT a tight budget. Reseeded with `npm run test:perf:update`.
